fomod.Name: DAGGER - Dark's Adaptive Goam & GoamEER Ear Retractor
fomod.Author: DarkAttentater
fomod.Description: DAGGER is an SKSE plugin that hides Goam's Elven Ears (Redone and/or the original) while a hood or helmet covers the head, and shows them again when it comes off. No plugin file, no scripts.
